9. Partners & Sponsors

Partner with Faith Nexus

Connect your organisation with an influential cross-sector audience spanning faith, media, technology, business, education, leadership and culture.

Request Partnership Information: partnersponsor@faithnexus.digital
Strategic Alignment

Why Partner?

Faith Nexus gives partners an opportunity to engage leaders, creators, institutions, and emerging voices from across Africa.

Partnership can provide brand visibility, thought-leadership opportunities, relationship-building, programme integration and direct engagement with delegates.

Engagement Tiers

Partnership Opportunities

01

Headline Partnership

High-level event association and visibility across all platforms and main stage plenaries.

02

Programme Partnership

Support major conversations, keynote panels, and programme environments.

03

Pillar Partnership

Align your organization with one of the seven Faith Nexus strategic pillars.

04

Industry Exhibition Partnership

Support the exhibition hall and corporate business engagement environment.

05

Nexus Studio

Partner with Faith Nexus' live media and digital content production environment.

06

Nexus Creators Lounge

Support one of the summit's primary creator networking and hospitality spaces.

07

CW100 Partnership

Associate with a premier platform recognising Christian influence impacting Africa.

08

Covenant Conversations

Support Jewish–Christian educational programming and bridge-building initiatives.

09

Broadcast & Technology

Provide technology, connectivity, production, media or distribution support.

Collaboration

Build Something Meaningful with Us

Faith Nexus welcomes conversations with organisations whose values and objectives align with the platform.
